questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: find an apartment for your first 2-4 weeks before you leave, then find a permanent apartment once you are in Barcelona - it is much easier in-person; get a public library card - you will have free entry to certain locations, e.g. Parc Guell; get a spanish SIM card - it'll just make life easier for you

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: take spanish classes at UPF - they're subsidized and you'll get a language certification upon completion; check out their culture & language landing programs as well
